After coordinator observes both CONVERGENCE_RELEASED reports it writes one convergence_complete_id. Both clients then enter _finish(true) concurrently and issue LEAVE concurrently. This simultaneous finalization is not part of convergence semantics and creates a Windows-sensitive shutdown/ACK race.
